description: This file defines an Angular component named SchedulesPageComponent for managing schedules within a frontend application. The component displays a list of schedules, provides a form for creating/editing schedules, and handles interactions such as loading data, resetting forms, saving updates, and deleting schedules.

classes.name: SchedulesPageComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for displaying and managing schedules with create, update, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and loads the schedules when the component is created.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of schedules from the ApiService and updates the component state.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Populates the form with data from a selected schedule for editing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the form to its default state for creating a new schedule.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current form data, either creating a new schedule or updating an existing one.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a schedule after user confirmation.
